entities.name: Phage
entities.description: An enemy against whom a war is waged, as seen by the clerics' ally.

entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: A sword-wielding leader who rallies his crew in battle aboard a ship.

entities.name: Hanna
entities.description: A companion of Gerrard who explains the nature of a device that does nothing.

entities.name: Sidar Jabari
entities.description: A speaker who holds that destiny cannot be changed.

entities.name: Ertai
entities.description: A wizard adept who meditates alone at a portal.

entities.name: Oracle en-Vec
entities.description: A prophetic speaker who foretells a vast shout and a vaster silence.

entities.name: Rashida Scalebane
entities.description: A speaker who calls war the crucible of leadership.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker and mind mage who is unimpressed by a pyromancer's onslaught.

entities.name: Zur the Enchanter
entities.description: A speaker who comments on the surprises of Krovikan sorcerers.

entities.name: Naimah
entities.description: A Femeref philosopher.

entities.name: Laquatus
entities.description: An ambassador who expects to see a foe again soon.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: An inventor who experiments with a portal and designs a silver golem; he waged war against Mishra.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's brother and Tocasia's student, who focused on a single goal and made malevolent creations.

entities.name: Tocasia
entities.description: A teacher of Urza and Mishra whose students studied flawed copies of Thran relics.

entities.name: Tawnos
entities.description: A researcher who solved the puzzle of Mishra's strange structures.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker and necromancer who advises on keeping malevolent beings in service.

entities.name: Cabal Patriarch
entities.description: A leader of the Cabal who speaks of chilling incantations.

entities.name: Afari
entities.description: The author of *Tales*, describing a land left barren by sand.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl
entities.description: A necromancer who calls Leshrac his liege.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: The liege to whom Lim-Dûl prays for power.

entities.name: Lyna
entities.description: A Soltari emissary who disdains the Dauthi.

entities.name: Chainer
entities.description: A dark figure who gives a dark gift to a darker soul.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: A cruel master who oversees implantations and trains flowstone.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: A man confined by sleep and defined by nightmare, seemingly filled with shadows.

entities.name: Orim
entities.description: A companion who wonders at the source of Crovax's strength.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: A figure served by priests who harness skirges.

entities.name: Shauku
entities.description: The Endbringer, who divines secrets by writing in her students' blood.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A silver golem who speaks on the repercussions of destruction.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: Captain of the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Jula
entities.description: A goblin raider who greets enemy scouts with his diplomacy helmet.

entities.name: Braids
entities.description: A dementia summoner who enjoys goblin deaths.

entities.name: Mwani
entities.description: A Mtenda goatherd who hates insects.

entities.name: Seton
entities.description: One who dreams of life renewed.

entities.name: Mirri
entities.description: A fighter who acts on reflex.

entities.name: Modruni
entities.description: A maro-sorcerer who guards a natural place against lifeless things.

entities.name: Marchesa
entities.description: The Black Rose, who sees all in Paliano as pawns.

entities.name: Gaea
entities.description: The force of nature that battles death with life.

entities.name: Genesis
entities.description: The first being through the Riftstone, which ended the world's lifelessness.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The world made a casualty of the war between Urza and Mishra.

entities.name: Mercadia
entities.description: A decadent city opposed by the Cho-Arrim.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: A place where death is far from permanent.

entities.name: Shiv
entities.description: The dragons' native land, likened to a sleeping dragon, now in smoldering ashes.

entities.name: Skirk Ridge
entities.description: A ridge from which goblins pour like lava.

entities.name: Krosan Forest
entities.description: A forest transformed by the Mirari's magic.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: A forest with traps, defenses and havens.

entities.name: Skyshroud
entities.description: A place menaced by an airborne scourge.

entities.name: Paliano
entities.description: A city where all are pawns in plays for power.

entities.name: Lowlands
entities.description: A region refusing to suffer under the High City.

entities.name: Ivory Tower
entities.description: A home of scholars who reward sacrificing power for knowledge.

entities.name: Femeref
entities.description: Homeland of the philosopher Naimah.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: A land whose sayings and war triangle are cited.

entities.name: Riftstone
entities.description: The stone through which Genesis first came.

entities.name: Cho-Arrim
entities.description: A people who fought Mercadia's decadence.

entities.name: Soltari
entities.description: A people opposed to the Dauthi.

entities.name: Dauthi
entities.description: A people who pay for murder, foes of the Soltari.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: A dark order led by the Cabal Patriarch.

entities.name: Keldons
entities.description: A people who smashed unfamiliar statues after a chimeric idol attacked them.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: A people whose scriptures and progress notes are quoted.

entities.name: Thran Empire
entities.description: An ancient empire whose relics were copied as su-chi.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: The ship captained by Sisay.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: A magical artifact that transformed the Krosan Forest.

events.summary: Gerrard draws his sword and jokes to his crew that the enemy should have brought a second ship.
events.quote: Gerrard grinned and drew his sword.

events.summary: Ertai meditates at a portal and realizes he is not alone.
events.quote: Alone at the portal, Ertai began his meditation.

events.summary: Jace feigns interest as a pyromancer unleashes her mightiest fire.
Urza discovers silver passes through the portal undamaged and designs a silver golem.
events.quote: He immediately designed a golem made of the metal.

events.summary: Orim wonders where Crovax's strength comes from.
events.quote: "Crovax seems filled only with shadows," thought Orim.

events.summary: Jula puts on his diplomacy helmet upon seeing enemy scouts.
events.quote: Jula grinned and strapped on his diplomacy helmet.

events.summary: Mirri reacts without time to think.
events.quote: Mirri did not have time to think, only to react.

events.summary: The Mirari's magic transforms the Krosan Forest and its inhabitants.
events.quote: The Mirari's magic transformed the Krosan Forest—and its inhabitants.

events.summary: Tawnos realizes Mishra's strange structures are themselves his creations.
After a chimeric idol attacks, the Keldons smash all unfamiliar statues.
events.quote: After a chimeric idol attacked them, the Keldons smashed all unfamiliar statues.

events.summary: Hanna explains to Gerrard that the device does nothing.
The war between Urza and Mishra makes Dominaria itself a casualty.
events.quote: the war between Urza and Mishra made Dominaria itself a casualty of war.

relations.quote: The Cho-Arrim fought Mercadia's decadence with more than just swords.
"Leshrac, my liege, grant me the power I am due."
Mishra listened well to her lessons on clarity of purpose.
Unlike his brother, he focused his mind on a single goal.
the war between Urza and Mishra made Dominaria itself a casualty of war.
"The Lowlands refuse to suffer at the whims of the High City."

rejected.summary: Dragons in Shiv's ashes strive to rebuild their land.
rejected.quote: In the smoldering ashes of Shiv, a few dragons strive to rebuild their native land.
